say: Step one, the need. In 2 to 3 sentences, say what problem you are solving and for whom.

Your solution: what you will do or supply

Next step: one sentence with a date

say: Use Reply by default. For an announcement, put your own address in To and all members in Bcc, so addresses stay private and nobody can Reply all.
In WhatsApp, an admin can make an announcement group where only admins post, with a separate group for discussion.

panel.heading: Writing to many people
left: Yourself in To, members in Bcc

say: Avoid Reply all for a simple thank you. Sent to 80 people, it wastes 80 people's time.
Check facts before forwarding. A message labelled Forwarded many times is more likely to be false.

panel.heading: Writing to many people
left: Yourself in To, members in Bcc

say: First, pause. Read the message twice and separate the facts from the feelings. If you are upset, wait at least an hour.

panel.heading: The LAST method for complaints
items: Listen: show you understood the problem
Acknowledge the feeling, without arguing
Solve: offer a specific fix
Thank them for telling you
panel.rule: Never reply in anger. Pause first.

say: Then use LAST. Listen: show you have understood the actual problem.

say: For example, Joy runs a cake business in Lagos. Tunde's cake arrived 3 hours late, and he is angry. Joy pauses and checks the facts. The rider was delayed, and she did not warn him.

card.title: Joy makes it right
card.note: Refund paid the same day, with the receipt shared.

say: She apologises, takes responsibility without excuses, and offers to refund the 5,000 naira delivery fee and 30 percent of the cake price, which is 9,000 naira.

card.title: Joy makes it right
card.note: Refund paid the same day, with the receipt shared.

say: That is 14,000 naira, paid today. Tunde accepts and thanks her for her honesty.
Joy adds a rule for herself: call the customer if delivery will be more than 30 minutes late.

card.title: Joy makes it right
card.note: Refund paid the same day, with the receipt shared.

say: To remember. A proposal answers five questions. Minutes record decisions and action points. Protect members' addresses with Bcc. Pause, then use LAST.
And handle disagreements privately. After three unproductive exchanges, suggest a call, then confirm in writing.

panel.heading: Remember
items: Proposal: need, solution, cost, why you, next step
Minutes: decisions and action points
Members in Bcc; Reply all only when needed
Pause, then Listen, Acknowledge, Solve, Thank
Never argue in public or shame anyone
